workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the_hermes_corpus_keeps_growing) -> PROVED -> [RETIRED]

watchme.trigger: each deposit_learning call landing under owner='hermes'
watchme.enough: when the corpus has taken deposits across 5 separate hermes sessions — a corpus that takes one deposit and then stops is the dead-store failure this watch exists to catch, and 5 sessions is enough to tell a live one from a launch artifact
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: a hermes-authored learning retrievable by counsel under owner='hermes', plus the deposit count over time
watchme.nexus: the hermes-owned corpus itself — the watch reads the thing it watches, which is the cheapest possible instrument here
watchme.consumer: CC, who is the other reader of that corpus and the first to notice if it goes stale

owner: CC builds the mapping; the hermes device owns the corpus it deposits into (owner='hermes'); cairn/tools/tree is a TOOL and has users, not an owner
children: none, because the whole ticket is a mapping plus four existing call sites
